verdict.rationale: Texas SOS's SOSPortal is an online filing, ordering and search portal, and a filing service could plausibly offer background automations such as scheduled filings or status-change triggers, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only manual, interactive features: drafts, a My Submissions status page, a shopping cart and pay-per-search access. Nothing shows user-configurable automations that run autonomously, and the filing host's robots.txt disallows AI agents by name.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
